question: If a + b = (3)/(4) and ab = (1)/(8), then the value of a⁴ + b⁴ + ab³ + ba³ is:
solution:
Given:

a + b = (3)/(4) and ab = (1)/(8)

Concept used:

(a + b)² = (a - b)² + 4ab

Calculation:

a + b = (3)/(4) ....(1)

⇒ (a + b)² = (9)/(16) (Squaring both side)

⇒ (a + b)2 - 4ab = (9)/(16) - 4ab

⇒ (a + b)2 - 4ab = (9)/(16) -
